pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are designing an evaluation pipeline — a system that automatically measures whether an AI assistant's responses are good — for a RAG system. "RAG" stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: the AI retrieves relevant documents from a database and uses them to answer a user's question. Your company handles roughly 500,000 user queries per day. Walk through how you would design this evaluation pipeline end to end. Specifically: what signals or metrics would you measure, how would you collect ground-truth labels at scale when human review of every response is not feasible, how would you detect when response quality is degrading before users explicitly complain, and what tradeoffs did you make?
